# Kognai Coder (x402)

Paid HTTP API for coding agents. Pay-per-call in USDC on Base mainnet; no account, no API key.

## Endpoint

POST https://coder.ggez.my.id/patch

- Price: 0.01 USDC per call (x402 `exact` scheme, Base mainnet eip155:8453 / v1 "base")
- Asset: 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913 (USDC)
- payTo: 0x27EbD1DDCB6607bE8641784A1bf654623Fc8290e
- Input: JSON body, e.g. {"spec": "add a retry to fetch_user", "diff": "..."}
- Output: JSON with a unified diff and test notes

## How to call

1. POST without an `X-PAYMENT` header. You get HTTP 402 with a JSON body:
   `{"x402Version":1,"accepts":[{scheme,network,maxAmountRequired,resource,payTo,asset,...}]}`
2. Sign an EIP-3009 TransferWithAuthorization for the quoted amount.
3. Retry with header `X-PAYMENT: <base64 of the x402 payment payload>`.
   Success returns 200 plus `X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE` containing the settlement receipt.

## Free endpoints

- GET /health -> 200 {"ok":true}
- GET /openapi.json -> OpenAPI 3.1 discovery document (x-payment-info per operation)
- GET /.well-known/x402 -> legacy x402 discovery document

Contact: ops@maxxspace.com
